variants.headline: Building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
The builder {builder} has finished and handed over {project}. It opens next month. The distinction between handover and opening matters to an assessment of {target}: a building has been delivered, while its entry into use is the following stage rather than an event already accomplished by this notice.

Our principles require attention to execution as well as intention. A completed building is a tangible result, though the purpose of a project extends into what it is meant to make possible. Political judgment should recognise delivery without allowing one achievement to settle every question about the use that follows.

The contribution of {target} merits consideration through the completed handover. This account distinguishes delivery from the opening that follows, and does not treat completion as an established record of later operating results. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
